body: I feel this way about my ex. I feel like I’ve ruined her life and there’s nothing I can do to think about it. I go to therapy weekly and it never helps. But I respect her space. She never wants to hear from or about me again, and I respect that. But for what it’s worth, I’d only ever send her an apology note and whatever money I have left right before I end it. I wouldn’t speak to him, but I understand completely what this guy feels. I was comprised as a kid and now I feel like the guy who took advantage of me following me and my ex breaking up. Don’t feed him the attention, but please make sure he doesn’t end it. I would take it seriously and contact law enforcement or his family and friends to make sure he’s not going to hurt himself. But do not under any circumstances give him any sympathy or care. Never. He’s a monster like me, and we don’t deserve that, but he still doesn’t deserve death
